brief:
Epidemiologists warn of escalating disease risks across Gaza's displacement camps, citing severe overcrowding, contaminated drinking water, collapsed sanitation systems, and critical shortages of medicines and medical supplies, Shehab Wire reported. Infectious disease cases and meningitis infections have surged dramatically, threatening the lives of thousands of displaced children and families.

The health crisis compounds as the conflict persists without resolution. Experts say the combination of unsanitary conditions and medical scarcity has created conditions where communicable diseases now pose a deadlier threat than direct combat casualties.
